The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Kandhar]] led a '''faction''' of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Kandhar sought to take over the White Maw, and allied with the Empire. However, a [[Voidhound|Republic smuggler]] exposed to his men that the deal would rob them of their independence from the Empire, leading them to [[Skirmish in the Tromper Crags Mineral Mine (Voidhound)|mutiny]] and flee [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
